package main

import (
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"example.com/plusminus/cmd"
)

//go:embed invocations.json
var invocationManifest []byte

func TestPlusMinusManifestErrors(t *testing.T) {
	var cases []struct { Args []string; Kind, Flag, Path string; Cause bool }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(invocationManifest, &cases); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	for _, tc := range cases {
		if tc.Kind == "" { continue }
		root, err := NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		err = root.Execute(tc.Args)
		var usage *cmd.UsageError
		if !errors.Is(err, cmd.ErrUsage) || !errors.As(fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", err), &usage) || string(usage.Kind) != tc.Kind || usage.Flag != tc.Flag || usage.CommandPath != tc.Path || (usage.Err != nil) != tc.Cause { t.Fatalf("%v: %#v error=%v", tc.Args, usage, err) }
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusTokenizer(t *testing.T) {
	option := func(key string) plusMinusOption { return plusMinusOption{Key: key, Boolean: true, SupportsBarePlus: true} }
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{"a": option("alpha"), "b": option("beta")}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"ab": option("ab")}
	for _, tc := range []struct { token string; keys, values []string; boundary, terminated bool; special string }{
		{"+ab", []string{"alpha", "beta"}, []string{"false", "false"}, false, false, ""},
		{"-ab", []string{"alpha", "beta"}, []string{"true", "true"}, false, false, ""},
		{"--ab", []string{"ab"}, []string{"true"}, false, false, ""},
		{"--ab=false", []string{"ab"}, []string{"false"}, false, false, ""},
		{"word", nil, nil, true, false, ""},
		{"+", nil, nil, true, false, ""},
		{"-", nil, nil, true, false, ""},
		{"--", nil, nil, false, true, ""},
		{"-h", nil, nil, false, false, "help"},
		{"--help", nil, nil, false, false, "help"},
		{"++help", nil, nil, false, false, "help"},
		{"--usage", nil, nil, false, false, "usage"},
		{"++usage", nil, nil, false, false, "usage"},
		{"--version", nil, nil, false, false, "version"},
		{"++version", nil, nil, false, false, "version"},
	} {
		token, err := tokenizePlusMinus(tc.token, "app", short, long)
		if err != nil { t.Fatalf("%s: unexpected err %v", tc.token, err) }
		var keys, values []string
		for _, operation := range token.Values { keys = append(keys, operation.Option.Key); values = append(values, operation.Value) }
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(keys, tc.keys) || !reflect.DeepEqual(values, tc.values) || token.Boundary != tc.boundary || token.Terminated != tc.terminated || token.Special != tc.special { t.Fatalf("%s: %#v", tc.token, token) }
	}
	// +h cannot be disabled or clustered
	if _, err := tokenizePlusMinus("+h", "app", short, long); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("+h should be rejected")
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusBoundariesAndAtomicClusters(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{"a": {Key: "alpha", Boolean: true, SupportsBarePlus: true, Set: func(string) error { calls++; return nil }}}
	for _, args := range [][]string{{"+az"}, {"-az"}, {"-ah"}, {"+a=value"}} {
		calls = 0
		if _, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus(args, "app", short, nil); err == nil || calls != 0 { t.Fatalf("partial cluster changed state: %v calls=%d error=%v", args, calls, err) }
	}
	subcmds := map[string]bool{"child": true}
	for _, tc := range []struct { prefix string; sub map[string]bool; start int }{
		{"child", subcmds, 0},
		{"--", nil, 1},
	} {
		args := []string{tc.prefix, "+childOnly", "--label=+a"}
		before := append([]string(nil), args...)
		tail, _, _, terminated, _, err := parsePlusMinus(args, "app", short, nil, tc.sub)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, before) || !reflect.DeepEqual(tail, before[tc.start:]) || &tail[0] != &args[tc.start] || terminated != (tc.prefix == "--") { t.Fatalf("boundary changed argv: %v -> %v (%v)", args, tail, err) }
	}
	interspersedTail, seenInter, commitInter, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"word", "-a"}, "app", short, nil)
	if err != nil || !seenInter["alpha"] || !reflect.DeepEqual(interspersedTail, []string{"word"}) {
		t.Fatalf("interspersed: tail=%v seen=%v err=%v", interspersedTail, seenInter, err)
	}
	if commitInter != nil {
		_ = commitInter()
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"label": {Key: "label", Set: func(s string) error { if s != "+a" && s != "val" { t.Fatalf("value rewritten: %q", s) }; return nil }}}
	if _, seen, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--label=+a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || !seen["label"] { t.Fatalf("attached value: %v %v", seen, err) }
	if _, seen, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--label", "+a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || !seen["label"] { t.Fatalf("separate plus value: %v %v", seen, err) }
	if _, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--label", "--verbose"}, "app", short, long); err == nil { t.Fatalf("expected error for flag-like separate value") }
}

func TestPlusMinusConversionAndErrors(t *testing.T) {
	value := 7
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"count": {Key: "count", Set: func(s string) error { n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); if err == nil { value = n }; return err }}}
	_, seen, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=0"}, "app", nil, long)
	if err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || value != 0 || !seen["count"] { t.Fatalf("conversion: %d %v %v", value, seen, err) }
	for _, tc := range []struct { args []string; kind cmd.UsageErrorKind; cause bool }{
		{[]string{"--count"}, cmd.UsageMissingFlagValue, false},
		{[]string{"--count=bad"}, cmd.UsageInvalidValue, true},
		{[]string{"--missing"}, cmd.UsageUnknownFlag, false},
		{[]string{"++a"}, cmd.UsageUnknownFlag, false},
	} {
		_, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus(tc.args, "app nested", nil, long)
		wrapped := fmt.Errorf("caller: %w", err)
		var usage *cmd.UsageError
		if !errors.Is(err, cmd.ErrUsage) || !errors.As(wrapped, &usage) || usage.Kind != tc.kind || usage.CommandPath != "app nested" || (usage.Err != nil) != tc.cause { t.Fatalf("typed failure: %#v %v", usage, err) }
		if tc.cause { var number *strconv.NumError; if !errors.As(err, &number) { t.Fatal("lost conversion cause") } }
	}
	ioError := errors.New("I/O acquisition")
	long["input"] = plusMinusOption{Key: "input", IO: true, Set: func(string) error { return ioError }}
	_, _, commitIO, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--input=file"}, "app", nil, long)
	if err != nil || commitIO == nil || commitIO() != ioError || errors.Is(err, cmd.ErrUsage) { t.Fatalf("I/O error reclassified: %v", err) }
}

func TestPlusMinusNonbooleanOperations(t *testing.T) {
	currentCount := 7
	opt := plusMinusOption{
		Key:               "count",
		SupportsBarePlus:  true,
		SupportsValuePlus: true,
		StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { currentCount = n; return nil }, nil
		},
		StageBarePlus: func() (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { currentCount = 7; return nil }, nil
		},
		StageValuePlus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { currentCount += n; return nil }, nil
		},
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"count": opt}

	// 1. Long minus with value
	currentCount = 0
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=10"}, "app", nil, long); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || currentCount != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("--count=10 failed: %v count=%d", err, currentCount)
	}

	// 2. Bare plus reset
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count"}, "app", nil, long); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || currentCount != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("++count reset failed: %v count=%d", err, currentCount)
	}

	// 3. Assigned plus operation
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count=3"}, "app", nil, long); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || currentCount != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("++count=3 failed: %v count=%d", err, currentCount)
	}

	// 4. Unsupported bare plus rejected
	unsupportedBare := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"count": {Key: "count", SupportsBarePlus: false, SupportsValuePlus: true},
	}
	if _, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count"}, "app", nil, unsupportedBare); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for unsupported ++count")
	}

	// 5. Unsupported assigned plus rejected
	unsupportedValue := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"count": {Key: "count", SupportsBarePlus: true, SupportsValuePlus: false},
	}
	if _, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count=5"}, "app", nil, unsupportedValue); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for unsupported ++count=5")
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusShortValueForms(t *testing.T) {
	aActive, bActive := false, false
	nVal := 0
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"a": {Key: "a", Boolean: true, SupportsBarePlus: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { aActive = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
		"b": {Key: "b", Boolean: true, SupportsBarePlus: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { bActive = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
		"n": {Key: "n", Boolean: false, StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { nVal = n; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}

	// Separate: -n 5
	aActive, bActive, nVal = false, false, 0
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-n", "5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-n 5 failed: %v n=%d", err, nVal)
	}

	// Attached without '=': -n5
	nVal = 0
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-n5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-n5 failed: %v n=%d", err, nVal)
	}

	// Attached with '=': -n=5
	nVal = 0
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-n=5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-n=5 failed: %v n=%d", err, nVal)
	}

	// Cluster with attached value: -abn5
	aActive, bActive, nVal = false, false, 0
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-abn5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || !aActive || !bActive || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-abn5 failed: %v a=%t b=%t n=%d", err, aActive, bActive, nVal)
	}

	// Cluster with attached '=': -abn=5
	aActive, bActive, nVal = false, false, 0
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-abn=5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || !aActive || !bActive || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-abn=5 failed: %v a=%t b=%t n=%d", err, aActive, bActive, nVal)
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusSingleCharLongNamespace(t *testing.T) {
	shortCalled, longCalled := false, false
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"a": {Key: "short-a", Boolean: true, SupportsBarePlus: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { shortCalled = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"a": {Key: "long-a", Boolean: true, SupportsBarePlus: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { longCalled = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}

	// -a triggers short
	shortCalled, longCalled = false, false
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || !shortCalled || longCalled {
		t.Fatalf("-a failed: short=%t long=%t err=%v", shortCalled, longCalled, err)
	}

	// --a triggers long
	shortCalled, longCalled = false, false
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || shortCalled || !longCalled {
		t.Fatalf("--a failed: short=%t long=%t err=%v", shortCalled, longCalled, err)
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusAtomicCommit(t *testing.T) {
	stagedVal := 10
	opt := plusMinusOption{
		Key: "count",
		StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { stagedVal = n; return nil }, nil
		},
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"count": opt}

	// First option valid, second option invalid conversion -> stagedVal remains unchanged
	_, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=99", "--count=invalid"}, "app", nil, long)
	if err == nil || stagedVal != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("atomic commit failed: val=%d err=%v", stagedVal, err)
	}

	// First option valid, second option unknown flag -> stagedVal remains unchanged
	_, _, _, _, _, err = parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=99", "--unknown"}, "app", nil, long)
	if err == nil || stagedVal != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("atomic commit failed: val=%d err=%v", stagedVal, err)
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusAssignedVsBare(t *testing.T) {
	assignedVal := "initial"
	optStr := plusMinusOption{
		Key:               "name",
		SupportsBarePlus:  false,
		SupportsValuePlus: true,
		StageValuePlus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { assignedVal = v; return nil }, nil
		},
	}
	longStr := map[string]plusMinusOption{"name": optStr}

	// 1. ++name= invokes configured assigned-plus with empty string
	_, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++name="}, "app", nil, longStr)
	if err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || assignedVal != "" {
		t.Fatalf("++name= failed: %v assignedVal=%q", err, assignedVal)
	}

	// 2. Flag supporting only assigned plus rejects bare plus ++name
	if _, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++name"}, "app", nil, longStr); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for bare plus ++name on assigned-only flag")
	}

	// 3. Flag supporting only bare plus rejects assigned plus ++flag= and ++flag=value
	optBareOnly := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"flag": {Key: "flag", SupportsBarePlus: true, SupportsValuePlus: false, StageBarePlus: func() (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { return nil }, nil
		}},
	}
	if _, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++flag="}, "app", nil, optBareOnly); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for ++flag= on bare-only flag")
	}
	if _, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++flag=value"}, "app", nil, optBareOnly); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for ++flag=value on bare-only flag")
	}

	// 4. Numeric empty string conversion failure returns typed strconv.NumError wrapped as cmd.UsageInvalidValue
	optNum := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"count": {
			Key:               "count",
			SupportsBarePlus:  true,
			SupportsValuePlus: true,
			StageValuePlus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
				_, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
				return func() error { return nil }, err
			},
		},
	}
	_, _, _, _, _, err = parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count="}, "app", nil, optNum)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for ++count=")
	}
	var usage *cmd.UsageError
	if !errors.As(err, &usage) || usage.Kind != cmd.UsageInvalidValue {
		t.Fatalf("expected UsageInvalidValue, got %#v", err)
	}
	var numErr *strconv.NumError
	if !errors.As(err, &numErr) {
		t.Fatalf("expected strconv.NumError cause in %#v", err)
	}

	// 5. Explicit boolean assignments
	// Default boolean (no plus-value:)
	defaultBool := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"enabled": {
			Key:              "enabled",
			Boolean:          true,
			SupportsBarePlus: true,
			StageBarePlus: func() (func() error, error) {
				return func() error { return nil }, nil
			},
		},
	}
	for _, arg := range []string{"++enabled=true", "++enabled=false", "++enabled="} {
		_, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{arg}, "app", nil, defaultBool)
		if err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("expected error for %s on default boolean flag", arg)
		}
		var u *cmd.UsageError
		if !errors.As(err, &u) || u.Kind != cmd.UsageInvalidValue {
			t.Fatalf("expected UsageInvalidValue for %s, got %#v", arg, err)
		}
	}

	// Boolean with plus-value: set
	boolVal := false
	plusValueBool := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"enabled": {
			Key:               "enabled",
			Boolean:           true,
			SupportsBarePlus:  true,
			SupportsValuePlus: true,
			StageBarePlus: func() (func() error, error) {
				return func() error { boolVal = false; return nil }, nil
			},
			StageValuePlus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
				b, err := strconv.ParseBool(v)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				return func() error { boolVal = b; return nil }, nil
			},
		},
	}
	// ++enabled=true sets true
	boolVal = false
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++enabled=true"}, "app", nil, plusValueBool); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || !boolVal {
		t.Fatalf("++enabled=true failed: %v boolVal=%t", err, boolVal)
	}
	// ++enabled=false sets false
	boolVal = true
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++enabled=false"}, "app", nil, plusValueBool); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || boolVal {
		t.Fatalf("++enabled=false failed: %v boolVal=%t", err, boolVal)
	}
	// ++enabled bare toggles to false
	boolVal = true
	if _, _, commit, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++enabled"}, "app", nil, plusValueBool); err != nil || commit == nil || commit() != nil || boolVal {
		t.Fatalf("++enabled failed: %v boolVal=%t", err, boolVal)
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusAtomicityBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
	// Scenario A: valid earlier flag + invalid later flag -> earlier flag not mutated
	stagedA := 10
	longA := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"a": {Key: "a", StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil { return nil, err }
			return func() error { stagedA = n; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}
	_, _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--a=99", "--a=notanumber"}, "app", nil, longA)
	if err == nil || stagedA != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("earlier flag mutated after later syntax/conversion error: stagedA=%d err=%v", stagedA, err)
	}

	// Scenario B: staged I/O flag + syntax/conversion failure -> no I/O acquired
	ioAcquired := false
	longIO := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"out": {Key: "out", IO: true, StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { ioAcquired = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
		"count": {Key: "count", StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			_, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			return nil, err
		}},
	}
	_, _, _, _, _, err = parsePlusMinus([]string{"--out=file.txt", "--count=bad"}, "app", nil, longIO)
	if err == nil || ioAcquired {
		t.Fatalf("I/O acquired despite conversion error: ioAcquired=%t err=%v", ioAcquired, err)
	}

	// Scenario C: custom plus operation + invalid later option -> custom function not invoked
	customCalled := false
	longCustom := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"counter": {Key: "counter", SupportsBarePlus: true, StageBarePlus: func() (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { customCalled = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}
	_, _, _, _, _, err = parsePlusMinus([]string{"++counter", "--unknown"}, "app", nil, longCustom)
	if err == nil || customCalled {
		t.Fatalf("custom plus operation called before invalid later option: customCalled=%t err=%v", customCalled, err)
	}

	// Scenario D: valid root flag + invalid child flag using full RootCmd / child Execute
	root, err := NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Initial Root.count is 7
	err = root.Execute([]string{"--count=99", "gnu", "--invalid-flag"})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for invalid child flag")
	}
	if root.count != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("root flag committed before child validation: root.count=%d (expected 7)", root.count)
	}

	// Scenario E: option assignment + missing required flag -> valid flag not mutated
	// When root or child has a required flag and it is missing, earlier options are not committed
	// (Tested via compiled app execution in TestPlusMinusManifestErrors / TestPlusMinusGenerationAndRuntime)

	// Scenario F: Plus-minus root with GNU child observing staged parent value
	root, err = NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root.count = 7
	err = root.Execute([]string{"--count=42", "gnu"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("root + gnu execution failed: %v", err)
	}
	if root.count != 42 {
		t.Fatalf("gnu child did not commit root count: %d (expected 42)", root.count)
	}

	// Scenario G: Plus-minus root with go-flag child observing staged parent value
	root, err = NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root.count = 7
	err = root.Execute([]string{"--count=55", "legacy"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("root + legacy execution failed: %v", err)
	}
	if root.count != 55 {
		t.Fatalf("legacy child did not commit root count: %d (expected 55)", root.count)
	}

	// Scenario H: Child validation failure leaves parent fields untouched
	root, err = NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root.count = 7
	err = root.Execute([]string{"--count=99", "gnu", "--invalid-flag"})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for invalid gnu child flag")
	}
	if root.count != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("parent count mutated after gnu child flag error: %d (expected 7)", root.count)
	}

	root, err = NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root.count = 7
	err = root.Execute([]string{"--count=99", "legacy", "-unknown-flag"})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for invalid legacy child flag")
	}
	if root.count != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("parent count mutated after legacy child flag error: %d (expected 7)", root.count)
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusHelpUsageVersionSemantics(t *testing.T) {
	for _, flag := range []string{"-h", "--help", "++help", "--usage", "++usage", "--version", "++version"} {
		root, err := NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Execute with flag; must succeed (exit 0) and not mutate fields
		if err := root.Execute([]string{flag}); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("flag %s failed: %v", flag, err)
		}
		if root.count != 7 {
			t.Fatalf("flag %s mutated count: %d", flag, root.count)
		}
	}
}
